name.japanese: スペイン・カリブ海戦隊
name.chineseSimplified: 西班牙加勒比海分舰队
name.chineseTraditional: 西班牙加勒比海分艦隊

globalDescription.english: At 09:35 the American squadron holds the blockade stations shown on the scenario map at 2 knots. All six Spanish ships start at sea in line ahead at 8 knots, spaced 400 yards apart. Brooklyn is limited to 16 knots. Standard fleet-loss scoring applies.
globalDescription.chineseSimplified: 09:35，美舰按原图的历史封锁阵位以 2 节巡弋。西班牙六舰开局均在海上，以 8 节组成单纵队，舰距 400 码。Brooklyn 限速 16 节。胜负按通用舰队损失规则判定。
